items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: Oh, well, I met her there, but I didn't really get to know her until later, later on.

ctx.x: Did you get to know Billie, Billie Holiday, there, or you just heard her there?

Oh, well, I met her there, but I didn't really get to know her until later, later on. But in fact she was the one that reminded me of it. She said, "You know, the first time I saw you," and she recalled it, and I said, "Oh, my goodness. That's right, that was you."
